summary: PIM Manager can now manage Power BI workspace roles, and its screens speak in calmer, plainer words.

new.title: Power BI workspace roles
new.text: PIM Manager can now add PIM groups to Power BI workspace roles. It only adds, never removes.
new.action: Run the workload prerequisites script once to grant the Fabric Administrator role.

new.title: Hybrid worker is a switch
new.text: The hybrid worker is now a feature you switch on. It is off by default.

new.title: Self-approve break-glass changes
new.text: Break-glass changes can be self-approved when self-approval is on.

fixes.title: Calmer dialogs and pages
fixes.text: Switch dialogs show one calm line with details behind More info. Guards say Protecting or Holding back changes, and Jobs shows no more overdue noise.
